title: Promos
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, various promos reveal behind-the-scenes moments, conflicts, and relationships among the office staff, including secret filming, character interactions, and upcoming storylines. The episode features humorous and tense moments, with characters discussing their relationships, privacy concerns, and reactions to the promos.
